messages:
Erin (Partnerships): Uploading draft co-branded playbook + solution brief for CloudAlpha. Attached: 2 PDF drafts, 3 logo files (png/svg/eps). Need quick check — design for layout, legal for trademark language, partner for logo lockup ok. Timeline: want to publish Tue EOD. @michael @sarah @james_cloudalpha

Michael (Design): Got it. Quick notes: prefer full-color lockup on light bg, single-column case study layout works. Can you share high-res eps for mark? The svg looks like it's missing outlines. Also we should tighten headline tracking.

Erin (Partnerships): Uploading `cloudalpha_lockup.eps` and `cloudalpha_mark.svg` now. PDFs are `CA-solution-brief-v1.pdf` and `CA-playbook-v1.pdf`.

partner-marketing-bot: New files uploaded to /partners/cloudalpha/2024-06-playbook — https://files.redwood.example/partners/cloudalpha/2024-06-playbook

James (CloudAlpha): Thanks! Confirm we approve full-color lockup on white, but need to keep tagline clearspace. I'll run by brand team, expect ok by tomorrow. Also: legal requires "CloudAlpha™" with ™ on first usage.

Sarah (Legal): pls change 'CloudAlpha' -> 'CloudAlpha™' on first use in playbook. Also need partner to sign logo usage addendum. Can we add this clause:

Sarah (Legal): ```
Logo usage addendum (summary):
"Partner grants non-exclusive, revocable license to Redwood Inference to reproduce Partner marks solely for marketing and co-branded collateral in connection with the joint solution. Partner warrants it owns or controls marks and will comply with agreed brand guidelines. Both parties may terminate usage with 30 days' notice."
```

Michael (Design): added smaller caption under logo per brand guidelines. Can we remove drop shadow on the lockup? Shadow looks low-res.

Erin (Partnerships): Removed shadow, updated PDFs to `CA-solution-brief-v2.pdf` and `CA-playbook-v2.pdf`. @james_cloudalpha can you confirm the case study quote is approved? We used the quote from last workshop.

James (CloudAlpha): Quote is fine. One nit: change "latency improvements of 40%" -> "up to 40%". Legal ok with that. Also uploaded updated brand guidelines: `CloudAlpha-brand-guidelines-2024.pdf` (see same files folder).

Sarah (Legal): I'll send the logo addendum to James for signature. Once we have a signed addendum + the 'up to' wording change, legal greenlights publishing.

Michael (Design): Final assets look good, exporting web-optimized PNGs now. ETA ~25 min.

Erin (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Target publish Tue EOD, I'll coordinate with Growth/Marketplace team for the listing and partner announcement cadence. :rocket:

James (CloudAlpha): Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll aim to return signed addendum by EOD tomorrow.

Erin (Partnerships): Noted — I'll hold final publish until signed addendum is in. If anyone else sees visual issues, flag here.

Michael (Design): One last check — open question for growth: do we need a separate 1-page marketplace thumbnail vs the solution brief? If yes I can produce a trimmed version.

Erin (Partnerships): Yes please — Growth asked for a 600x400 thumbnail + 1-paragraph summary. Michael, can you create both in the same export?

Michael (Design): Yep. Will include `CA-playbook-thumb-600x400.png` and `CA-playbook-summary.txt` in the uploads.
